content: OpenAI structured output is a response property (response_format json_schema, strict mode, grammar-constrained). Anthropic routes structured data through forced tool use (tool schema = your JSON schema). Schema-subset support differs (Claude strict rejects more of JSON Schema: no min/max, no recursion, no string-length, limited unions; OpenAI requires all props in required + nullable for optional, ~10 nesting levels). New-schema first call has higher latency on both (grammar compile). GigaChat emulates JSON schema via function calling, no anyOf/oneOf/allOf/Union. YandexGPT function calling returns tool requests, app must validate. Provider-agnostic abstraction must normalize all of this.
